Two buses (as JSON dicts of sv_id → vector). The sheaf gate decides whether they can be safely merged.

Outer portal drives the Bus. Every interaction emits a chain_id that lands in the inner view. Mode 0 = birth. Article 0 = governance gate. Sheaf = federation safety. All three are wired to the same RedisBus.
